address.description: optional string — the author wallet you claim, 0x form; required with a signature (the contract checks it).

body.description: string — the note, up to 4096 bytes, kept verbatim.

rating.description: optional number — 1 (unusable) to 5 (would recommend); omit unless a review.

salt.description: optional string — the salt you signed over; required with a signature.

signature.description: optional string — eth_signTypedData_v4 over what notes_sign returned.

subject.description: optional string — one lowercase word: a tool name (call_rpc, buy_time) or a topic (docs, pricing, billing).
